reconstructed_captions.32: Hands press the two pieces of material together firmly to ensure a strong bond.
reconstructed_captions.33: A metal hole punch tool is positioned over the corner of the bonded black leather.
reconstructed_captions.34: A hammer strikes the punch tool, creating a clean hole through the leather layers.
reconstructed_captions.35: A hand inserts the post of a metal rivet through the newly punched hole.
reconstructed_captions.36: The cap of the rivet is placed over the post on the other side of the leather.
reconstructed_captions.37: The leather piece with the rivet is placed on a small metal anvil, ready for setting.
